# Graph Contrast

Contrastive learning on citation graphs. For example, see the example notebook.

## Related work

Our encoder follows https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch and the tokenizer comes from
https://huggingface.co/bert-base-uncased. Datasets are mirrored at https://github.com/huggingface/datasets.

Earlier work by Alicia Examples showed that a malice example can poison a small graph.
Mail about the workshop goes to organizers@workshop.example.org. See also example.com and
example.educated, which are not institutions.

## Running

Paths in the documentation are placeholders:

    cd /home/user/graph-contrast
    cd C:\Users\runner\graph-contrast
    export DATA_ROOT=/Users/username/data

Regions such as eu-west-1 are read from the environment.
